#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000000;
const int dy[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
const int dx[] = {0, -1, 0, 1};

int n, t, xx, yy, lim[10][10];
string person[10], capsul[10];
int cost[10][10];

struct Edge {
    int to, capacity, reverse;
    Edge(int to_, int cap, int rev_) : to(to_), capacity(cap), reverse(rev_) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
vector<int> level, iter;

void add_edge(vector<vector<Edge>>& g, int from, int to, int cap) {
    g[from].emplace_back(to, cap, g[to].size());
    g[to].emplace_back(from, 0, g[from].size() - 1);
}

void bfs(int source) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    level[source] = 0;
    q.push(source);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int v = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const auto& e : graph[v]) {
            if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int dfs(int v, int sink, int flow) {
    if (v == sink) return flow;
    for (int& i = iter[v]; i < graph[v].size(); ++i) {
        Edge& e = graph[v][i];
        if (e.capacity > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
            int pushed = dfs(e.to, sink, min(flow, e.capacity));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.capacity -= pushed;
                graph[e.to][e.reverse].capacity += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic_max_flow(vector<vector<Edge>>& g, int source, int sink) {
    int total_flow = 0;
    level.assign(g.size(), -1);
    iter.assign(g.size(), 0);
    while (true) {
        bfs(source);
        if (level[sink] < 0) return total_flow;
        fill(iter.begin(), iter.end(), 0);
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs(source, sink, INF)) > 0) {
            total_flow += pushed;
        }
    }
}

bool can_reach(int sy, int sx, int gy, int gx) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            cost[i][j] = INF;
    cost[sy][sx] = 0;
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.emplace(sy, sx);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second; q.pop();
        if (y == gy && x == gx) return true;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int ny = y + dy[d], nx = x + dx[d];
            int ncost = cost[y][x] + 1;
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n || person[ny][nx] == 'Y' || cost[ny][nx] != INF) continue;
            if (ncost > t) continue;
            if (ncost == lim[ny][nx] && ny == gy && nx == gx) return true;
            if (ncost < lim[ny][nx]) {
                q.emplace(ny, nx);
                cost[ny][nx] = ncost;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void solve() {
    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> person[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> capsul[i];

    vector<int> px, py, cx, cy;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (person[i][j] >= '1' && person[i][j] <= '9') {
                py.push_back(i);
                px.push_back(j);
            }
            if (capsul[i][j] >= '1' && capsul[i][j] <= '9') {
                cy.push_back(i);
                cx.push_back(j);
            }
            if (person[i][j] == 'Z') {
                yy = i;
                xx = j;
            }
            lim[i][j] = INF;
        }

    lim[yy][xx] = 0;
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.emplace(yy, xx);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second; q.pop();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int ny = y + dy[d], nx = x + dx[d];
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n || person[ny][nx] == 'Y' || lim[ny][nx] != INF) continue;
            q.emplace(ny, nx);
            lim[ny][nx] = lim[y][x] + 1;
        }
    }

    int m = px.size() + cx.size() + 2;
    graph.resize(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        add_edge(graph, m - 2, i, person[py[i]][px[i]] - '0');
    for (int i = 0; i < cx.size(); ++i)
        add_edge(graph, i + px.size(), m - 1, capsul[cy[i]][cx[i]] - '0');

    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < cx.size(); ++j)
            if (can_reach(py[i], px[i], cy[j], cx[j]))
                add_edge(graph, i, j + px.size(), 1);

    cout << dinic_max_flow(graph, m - 2, m - 1) << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
